title: Scale Prediction
description: Item 5/6/8's mandatory 'predict scale/size before choosing a structure/algorithm' checklist artifact. Required for the e2e-validation plan generated by legion_review.py on feature-improvement approval.

feature.description: The feature/change this prediction is for.

rows.description: Expected row/record count at steady state.

qps.description: Expected queries/calls per second (0 for batch-only).

chosen_structure.description: Data structure picked to match the predicted scale (e.g. set, dict, deque, DataFrame).

chosen_algorithm.description: Algorithm/approach picked to match the predicted scale (e.g. vectorized, streaming, O(1) index lookup).

rationale.description: Why this structure/algorithm fits the predicted scale — the performance/cost trade-off reasoning.

reconsider_if.description: Optional: the scale threshold at which this choice should be revisited.
